name: Perplexity AI
monetization: Sells Pro/Max subscriptions to an AI answer engine and the Comet browser; building toward commerce and OEM distribution revenue while sharing revenue with publishers.
description_md: Perplexity is the leading independent AI-native search challenger: an answer engine that cites sources, plus the Comet agentic browser launched in 2025. It reached a ~$23B valuation in its January 2026 round on $450M+ ARR — roughly 175× its April 2023 valuation in under three years — and has repeatedly used audacious M&A bids (Chrome, TikTok-US) as positioning. It rents rather than trains frontier models, riding on OpenAI/Anthropic/open-weight backends.
ai_monetization_md: Revenue is mainly consumer subscriptions (Pro/Max tiers) plus enterprise seats and API, with ARR passing ~$450M by early 2026. It has committed spend the other way too — a reported $750M Azure commitment (Jan 2026). Distribution deals are the growth bet: Comet reached 3M+ MAU, launched free on iOS in March 2026, and Perplexity powers Samsung's Bixby on the Galaxy S26 — the first OS-level assistant deal outside Google. A publisher revenue-share program pays media partners whose content appears in answers, a hedge against the scraping lawsuits that dog the category.
ai_strategy_md: Own the query, not the model: differentiate on product speed and citations, buy model capacity from multiple labs, and convert answers into commerce (shopping, bookings) where per-query economics beat ad-search margins. OEM distribution (Samsung; Motorola) attacks Google's default-placement moat directly — timed to the remedies phase of the Google antitrust cases. The January 2026 round (investors across rounds include Nvidia, SoftBank Vision Fund 2, IVP, Accel, Bezos) funds a compute ramp and browser marketing.
risk_notes_md: Valuation is ~50× ARR on a consumer-heavy revenue base with low switching costs, squeezed from above by Google's Gemini-in-Search and ChatGPT's search mode. Model dependency: it rents frontier models from labs that are also competitors. Legal risk from publishers (News Corp/Dow Jones suits) persists despite the rev-share program. The $23B January 2026 mark is reported by trackers and secondary press rather than a tier-1 outlet with deal documents; some coverage puts it at $22.6B.

observations.notes: January 2026 round (Series E-6); some trackers report $22.6B. No tier-1 press confirmation of final terms located — treated as a secondary-tracker figure. Private round mark, not a traded price.
$450M+ ARR crossing into 2026; some estimates run to ~$500M. Value is a floor.
Reported $750M committed to Microsoft Azure in Jan 2026; single secondary source — low confidence.

events.title: Raises at ~$23B valuation with $450M+ ARR
events.why_it_matters: Prices the independent AI-search challenger at ~50× ARR and funds the Comet browser push — the sector's cleanest test of whether answer engines can dent Google's distribution moat.

events.title: Comet browser launches free on iOS, hits #3 on US App Store
events.why_it_matters: Distribution is the whole game for AI search; Comet's traction (3M+ MAU) plus the Samsung Bixby deal on Galaxy S26 are the first real evidence Perplexity can reach users without paying Google-scale default fees.
